snippet.title: BULLET BRAIN -- GAMEPLAY TRAILER
snippet.description:
Play the Bullet Brain demo now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4466820/Bullet_Brain_Demo/

Bullet Brain is a difficult top-down shooter where you jump from body to body to stay alive, wielding the weapons of enemies you possess to clear short handcrafted levels.

Music by Harvey M. Bee
